name: Kitchen
description: Kitchen word search puzzles gather utensil and prep English — apron, colander, skillet, whisk, drawer, chop and boil — for adults who live near a stove. Free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. No timer, no account and no appliance-brand names: just the shared language of home cooking. Sits beside Food, Cooking, Baking, Breakfast and Coffee & Tea. Prefer bigger letters? Open large print. New to the site? See how to play, then warm up on an easy kitchen grid.
